scenes.narration: Nine forty at night. Amaka is cleaning her brushes after a long day. Hands full. The phone buzzes. "Hi dear, how much for bridal makeup?"
scenes.visualInstructions: character-scene. Amaka at her station, a brush in one hand, phone in the other, worried. Phone lights up. [SFX: message pop]

props.label: Hi dear, how much for bridal makeup?

scenes.narration: She types the answer she has typed many times. Forty-five thousand naira. Last price? It is the last price. Let me check and get back to you.
scenes.visualInstructions: story, mocked DM, labelled Illustration. Five messages one at a time: "Hi dear, how much for bridal makeup?", "₦45,000", "Ahh. Last price?", "That's the last price dear", "Ok let me check and get back to you", then "Seen · 3 days ago". Fictional client Chioma O. One full beat of silence after the narration. [SFX: seen tick] [GIF]

lines.text: Chioma O.: Hi dear, how much for bridal makeup?
Amaka: That's the last price dear
Chioma O.: Ok let me check and get back to you

scenes.narration: Then nothing. Tomorrow someone else asks the same question, and it starts again. And checking. And checking.
scenes.visualInstructions: transformation, labelled Illustration. A "Still checking." stamp lands on the chat, then the chat slides into a pile of the same chat from Bisi A. and Kemi T. [SFX: stamp thud] [GIF]

scenes.narration: The price only lives inside each chat, so every client has to ask. The usual way, you type it again in every chat. A better way, one link with the price already on it. What if the price was already there before they asked?
scenes.visualInstructions: comparison. The usual way: the price typed again in every chat. A better way: one link with the price already on it. [SFX: reveal]

left.title: The usual way
points: The price typed again in every chat

right.title: A better way
points: One link with the price already on it

scenes.narration: In Iker, you set it up once. On the Rate card, each service gets its price, its duration and its deposit.
scenes.visualInstructions: product, iPad frame. iker-rate-card: the Rate card with each service's price. Demo data.

scenes.narration: Services sit in packages, each with its own booking steps.
scenes.visualInstructions: product, iPad frame. iker-packages: services grouped into packages. Demo data.

scenes.narration: And on Availability, you set your weekly hours and block the days you are away.
scenes.visualInstructions: product, iPad frame. iker-availability: Weekly hours, then Blocked dates. Demo data.

scenes.narration: Clients only see your link. Every service shows its price, and only times you are really open can be picked. Before they pay, they read your policy and tick to accept it. All of this is there before the first message. The business on screen is made-up demo data.
scenes.visualInstructions: product, iPad frame. iker-amaka-client-books-tablet: booking page with the rate card and price, open times, then Pay & confirm with the policy. Zoom on the price, then on the policy line.

cues.phrase: only times you are really open

scenes.narration: They pay the deposit by bank transfer, straight to your account, and upload their proof. Iker records it. It does not take the money. You look at the proof. If it is right, tap Confirm booking, and the slot is booked. If not, tap Reject payment.
scenes.visualInstructions: decision, motion graphic, labelled Illustration. Proof uploaded, then two branches: Confirm booking, or Reject payment. [SFX: confirm chime]

scenes.narration: Next time someone asks how much, send the link. Same price. Same Amaka. One less chat.
scenes.visualInstructions: character-scene, labelled Illustration. Amaka relaxed. Phone shows "Deposit paid ₦15,000, Chioma O.".

scenes.narration: Get started at useiker.com, and the Iker team sets up your booking page with you. No commission on bookings or deposits.
scenes.visualInstructions: cta. Terracotta slab, emblem, white headline.
